_about: How two customer-app versions are ordered: Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 precedence.
BOTH sides of the version gate are tested against this one file: the API
works if the server and the phone agree about which of two versions is newer, so a new case
goes HERE, never into one suite's own list.
ascending: each list is in strictly increasing order, every pair of it, not only neighbours.
equal: each pair compares equal (build metadata after '+' is ignored).
invalid: each string must refuse to parse.
